title: Olusuku olwabula mu kiro kimu
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’olusuku olujjudde ebibala, oluzitowa ebibala ebikungudde era nga lwetooloddwa emiti emiwanvu. Abo abaali bagulabirira baali beefuula abagezigezi, nga bateekateeka amakungula gaabwe mu ssaawa ezisirifu ng’obudde tebunnakya, nga tebuliimu maaso g’abo abali mu bwetaavu. Naye Oyo atasula yalina enteekateeka endala ez’obugabi bwabwe obukwese. Osobola okuteebereza ani ayimiridde emabega w’olugero luno olw’okwegendereza okuva mu Quran?
clues: Lumu twalina olusuku olujjudde ebimera era nga lujjudde nnyo ne lufuuka obuggya eri bonna abaali bayitawo.
Mu nteekateeka yaffe, twayombagana ku makya ennyo, nga tulangirira nti tewali mwoyo gwa bwetaavu gwali gugenda kukkirizibwa kuyingira ku lunaku olwo.
Twali bantu ba bugagga, era emitima gyaffe gyali gizibye amaaso nga tetulaba ddembe ly’abaavu abaali batwetoolodde.
Enkya y’amakungula gye twali tugenderera bwe yatuuka, twasemberera olusuku lwaffe ne tusanga nga lufuuse amatongo agaddugala mu kiro kimu.
Ekiragiro eky’amaanyi kyabuna, ne kitalekawo kintu kirala okuggyako evvu ebibinja by’ebibala ebikungu we byali biwanikiddwa edda.
Enfumo yaffe kulabula kwa maanyi okwawandiikibwa mu Quran, gye tumanyiddwa nga bannannyini lusuku abaagaana abali mu bwetaavu obuzirakisa.

identity.label: Nze Ani?
options: Bannannyini Lusuku
Abantu b'Empuku
Abayigirizwa ba Is
Abaswahaba b’Enku
Abagenyi ba Ibrahim

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Okukungula ebibala mu nkukutu n’okuziyiza abaavu
Okwebaka okumala ebyasa bingi munda mu mpuku
Okugaana okuvaamu engamiya enkazi okuva mu mayinja
Nga basinza ennyana eya zaabu ku Lusozi Sinaayi
Okuzimba eryato eddene okusobola okuwona amataba
trial.answer: Okukungula ebibala mu nkukutu n’okuziyiza abaavu

location.label: Ekintu Ekikulu
options: Olusuku oluliko bbugwe nga lujjudde enkindu n’emizabbibu
Empuku enzikivu mu buziba bw’ensozi
Ekibuga ekyatuukiddwako omuyaga ogw’obwakatonda
Ekiwonvu ekitukuvu okumpi n’Enyumba ya Allah
Embalama z’omugga ogukulukuta
location.answer: Olusuku oluliko bbugwe nga lujjudde enkindu n’emizabbibu

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Olusuku lwayokebwa ekiragiro eky’omuliro ekyava mu ggulu
Baasula mu mirembe okumala emyaka 309 egy’omwezi
Enkuba y’amayinja yabatonnye
Zabbira wansi w’amayengo g’amataba amangi
Baasaasaanyizibwa empewo ennyogovu era eyali efuukuuse
outcome.answer: Olusuku lwayokebwa ekiragiro eky’omuliro ekyava mu ggulu

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew. (68:33)
